name: Demecser (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of white, green and white in the ratio 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the town arms of Demecser (a green shield with a tower, ears of grain and a fish, within a yellow wreath) above the name DEMECSER in green.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
